message.snowwaifuspell.teleport_and_sit: Snow Waifu has been teleported and sat down
item.snowwaifuspell.snowqueensoul.desc1: A soul imbued with the power of the Snow Queen
item.snowwaifuspell.snowqueensoul.desc2: Its darkness has been purified. Use to gain Level III XP and a spell scroll to command her
item.snowwaifuspell.snowqueensoul.lore1: "In the pure white snow, she embraces the darkness"
item.snowwaifuspell.snowqueensoul.lore2: "In the silence of death, she is reborn"
snowwaifuspell.configuration.general.too: Top-level switches. Every level-dependent value follows one rule: level1 + per_level x (level - 1). So level 1 uses level1 as-is, level 2 adds one per_level, level 3 adds two, and so on.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.general.per: The Snow Waifu exists forever; all of [duration] is ignored. Forced to true when the 'Truly Best Friends Forever' mod is installed.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.general.bos: Whether the Snow Queen drops her soul when killed. The loot table is only read when a world loads, so reload the world after changing this.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.health.tool: Computed as level1 + per_level x (level - 1). With the shipped defaults (35 and 60) that gives 35 / 95 / 155 for spell levels 1 / 2 / 3.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.health.leve: The value used at spell level 1. Level 2 uses this plus one per_level, level 3 uses this plus two.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.health.per_: Added once for every spell level above 1. Example: level1 = 35 and per_level = 60 give 35 / 95 / 155 for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.health.scal: When enabled, the health computed above is multiplied by the caster's spell power (Iron's Spells). Disable it if you want the numbers above to be the exact in-game health.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.damage.tool: These three skills are flat values and do NOT scale with spell power - only melee damage and max health do. Each one still follows level1 + per_level x (level - 1).
snowwaifuspell.configuration.damage.brea: Cone-shaped damage over time. With the shipped defaults (2.5 and 2.5) the damage is 2.5 / 5.0 / 7.5 for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
The value used at spell level 1. Level 2 uses this plus one per_level, level 3 uses this plus two.
Added once for every spell level above 1. Example: 2.5 and 2.5 give 2.5 / 5.0 / 7.5 for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
Long-range beam. With the shipped defaults (4.0 and 1.5) the damage is 4.0 / 5.5 / 7.0 for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
The value used at spell level 1. Level 2 uses this plus one per_level, level 3 uses this plus two.
Added once for every spell level above 1. Example: 4.0 and 1.5 give 4.0 / 5.5 / 7.0 for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.damage.icic: Homing projectile. With the shipped defaults (3.0 and 2.5) the damage is 3.0 / 5.5 / 8.0 for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
The value used at spell level 1. Level 2 uses this plus one per_level, level 3 uses this plus two.
Added once for every spell level above 1. Example: 3.0 and 2.5 give 3.0 / 5.5 / 8.0 for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.duration.to: Computed as level1_seconds + per_level_seconds x (level - 1). With the shipped defaults (300 and 150) the duration is 300 / 450 / 600 seconds for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.duration.le: Summon time in seconds at spell level 1. Level 2 adds one per_level_seconds, level 3 adds two. Ignored while Permanent is enabled.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.duration.pe: Seconds added once for every spell level above 1. Example: 300 and 150 give 300 / 450 / 600 seconds for levels 1 / 2 / 3.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.cooldown.to: All values are in ticks, and 20 ticks = 1 second. So the shipped default of 60 ticks means 3 seconds, and 300 ticks means 15 seconds.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.cooldown.br: Cone of Cold: how long one breath lasts. 20 ticks = 1 second, so the default 60 ticks = 3 seconds.
Cone of Cold: the gap between two breaths. 20 ticks = 1 second, so the default 60 ticks = 3 seconds.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.cooldown.ic: How often the Icicle skill can fire. 20 ticks = 1 second, so the default 40 ticks = 2 seconds.
How often the Ray of Frost skill can fire. 20 ticks = 1 second, so the default 160 ticks = 8 seconds.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.cooldown.fr: How often the Frostwave skill can fire. 20 ticks = 1 second, so the default 240 ticks = 12 seconds.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.cooldown.ic: How often the Ice Block skill can fire. 20 ticks = 1 second, so the default 300 ticks = 15 seconds.
snowwaifuspell.configuration.mysterious_: Give the Snow Queen a bust
Adds a bust to the Snow Queen. Purely cosmetic, client-side only, off by default. Takes effect as soon as the config is reloaded - no restart needed.
